value.rationale: The hypothesis is the first nontrivial departure from pair-product uniqueness, a canonical structural condition in Sidon/B2 and Lambda(4) analysis. The result completely classifies all three possible one-relation geometries, gives exact sharp constants and equality cases, and shows that extra collision-free characters cannot appear in extremizers. It is a reusable structural lemma rather than a fixed numerical exercise.
